notes: Big words all explained on the spot: amber, drones, nectar, hexagons, waggle dance. 'One jar' vs pack 'one pound' and 'painted' jars are harmless simplifications. Juno picks the flower-finder job, spots the queen and tests the hexagon fit, so she is active.

Omar is not active: Ting starts every jump ('Ting the bell jingled', 'The bell rang again') and gives every fact, and Omar only rides each bike and reacts ('Whoa', 'No way', 'Nailed it'). Nothing he does changes what happens. Words (patent, derailleurs, bloomers) are all explained, and the facts match the pack.

Tom catches the falling penny-farthing rider and his suggestions set up each next stop. Laufmaschine, velocipede, patented, pneumatic and derailleurs are all explained. Dunlop 'vet', 'Belfast' and 'son's tricycle' are not in the pack but are minor colour, not substantial claims. 'cassette' is a simile, fine for band C.

Sam is not active: Tiko picks every stop ('Somewhere SILKY', 'Ready for something HUGE?') and explains everything. Sam's tries all fail with no effect (hand on window, railing climb), and otherwise he waves and says 'Whoa'. Microscope and scientists are explained, the facts are fine, and the goat-cliff wobble is answered at once.

Borderline on participation, but Rosa starts the adventure ('Isla, look!'), Isla works out the hoof grip and the 'two tools' idea herself, and she calms Rosa about the spider. 'special gloves' stretches f14's handheld paddle, but a hand-worn gecko grip for glass is close enough. Hooves are explained.

Facts: the trip is set '230 million years' back, then Pip says 'About 66 million years after this... most dinosaurs went away'. The pack (f2) says extinction was 66 million years AGO. Also 'a flying reptile, a cousin of lizards' for pterosaurs is not in the pack (f16 says related to dinosaurs). The legend dog is hedged correctly, and words are explained.

The asteroid level builds lasting tension but resolves calmly, and a level 2 is allowed in C. Theo finds the trace fossil and frees the bone with Mary. The legend dog is hedged. Thagomizer joke origin and 'good mother lizard' are minor true additions. A defect outside the five judgements: chapter 7 is a truncated duplicate ('"Nests,') of chapter 8.

Proboscis, nectar, honey stomach, honeycomb, pollen and scout bee are each explained, within the budget of 6. 'more than a thousand eggs. Every single day' slightly firms up the pack's 'sometimes over a thousand' but does not contradict it. Finn sips and passes the nectar, and Nell counts the six sides.
